findings.official_title: Deputy General Manager (AI Governance and Compliance), fixed term
findings.criteria: Apply online 19 Oct to 9 Nov 2026; cut-off date 30 Sep 2026. Education: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Electrical and Electronics, or Electronics and Communication, or equivalent; or M.Sc (Statistics or Computer Science), MA (Statistics), M Stat or MCA. Preferred: MBA/PGDM with finance specialisation; certification in ML/AI, NLP, web crawling or neural networks. Experience: 10+ years in banking, BFSI or IT, including 2+ years in a senior leadership role in AI governance, responsible AI, model risk management, regulatory compliance, data privacy, information security or technology risk and business transformation. Individual-contributor experience does not count toward senior leadership. Age: 35 to 50 (as read from the advertisement table). Registration is complete only when the fee is paid online on or before the last date.
